title: Emigration Canyon General Plan 2022 (adopted March 22 2022)
notes: First and current General Plan since 2017 metro-township incorporation; adopted while still Emigration Canyon Metro Township (converted to CITY 2024-05-01). Land-use context doc. 7 chapters (Intro, Land Use & Character Areas, Transportation, Economic Development, Environment, Resilience & Infrastructure, Community Work Program). NO standalone Moderate Income Housing element/chapter: housing appears only within Land Use/Economic Development discussion (cost-burden, housing options) — consistent with Emigration Canyon (~1,600 pop) being below the Utah Code 10-9a-403 'specified municipality' 5,000-population MIH threshold. A print-layout version (View/254) and Appendix A-L (View/253, incl. Appendix D housing cost-burden data) also exist on the MSD site; not retained (duplicate/supplementary). Born-digital clean text (extracted without -layout).
